items.content:
Japanese — the art of sequencing a task well. Planning the order of
operations so nothing waits on anything else. Pikmin is built entirely
around it and there's no English word, so the localisation just uses it.

We have "logistics", which is about moving things, and "efficiency",
which is about waste. Neither is about the *arranging*.

summary: Japanese word for well-sequenced tasks, untranslatable in English
title: dandori
